name: Golden City Cell — 390×844 Portrait Composition
scope: One reusable 64m × 64m city cell; it must be evaluated in actual gameplay camera view, not a static editor-only approximation.

worldSpaceSpatial.semantics: World-space openness. The probe samples a 1m grid on the xz plane over the union of the real GROUND tile worldBounds and counts a sample open when no solid occupant footprint (BUILDING, TREE, POI, static vehicle environment node) covers it; roads and walkways are walkable and never blocking, and COLLECTIBLE/RESOURCE_CLUSTER cover is reported separately because it is absorbable. This is NOT mandatoryComposition.largeEmptyGroundMaxPercent, which is a screen-space ratio of large empty ground regions inside the 390x844 frame. The two metrics have different semantics, respond to different changes, and must never be substituted for one another: a cell can be screen-dense and world-open, or screen-sparse and world-cluttered.

required: Creator viewport screenshot with named-cell overlay
real player navigation and a moving-vehicle observation
